player_prompt.intro:
Keddi Player {player_id}. Keddi tawḍeɣt Memory Game.
Elɣwel-ik ikka-d tamuɣli n uɣanib n teskawin n tewṛa, walu ɣas n uɣanib-ik.
Di tawḍeɣt-ik, ffeɣ tawṛa n teskawin sin ɣef tewṛa n uɣanib n yifassen d wuṭṭunen n teskawin n yifassen n tewṛa n yifassen, am '[0 1 1 0]', manik tewṛa tamaẓẓayt tewṛa n uɣanib 0 d wuṭṭun 1, d tewṛa tamaẓẓayt tewṛa n uɣanib 1 d wuṭṭun 0.
Ma tewṛa n teskawin sin tewṛa, ikka-d tamuɣli d teskawin tewṛa n tewṛa. Ma ur tewṛa, teskawin tewṛa n tewṛa, am '.'.
Tawḍeɣt tewṛa mi ɣas n uɣanib n teskawin tewṛa.
